system.description:
Category: Skill

You have honed your ability to shape your personality and visage into that of others with a surprising level of detail. You gain the following benefits:

You gain proficiency with the Disguise kit. If you are already proficient, you instead gain Mastery.

When a creature sees through your Impersonate, you can use your Reaction to Fast Talk it. On a success, the creature only becomes suspicious instead of recognizing that you aren’t who you claim to be.

As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Charge from your Disguise Kit to switch into a Plain disguise you prepared earlier. You can have only one prepared disguise at a time. If you’re Hidden or out of sight, you can also use Create Diversion as part of the same Bonus Action.

Creating a disguise with a Disguise Kit takes you less time:

Plain: 1 minute

Elaborate: 10 minutes

Exquisite: 1 hour
